title: Domain 3 practice: technology and services (34%)

kcs.statement: Domain 3 (Cloud Technology and Services, 34%, the largest) has eight task statements: deploying and operating, global infrastructure, compute, database, network, storage, AI/ML and analytics, and other in-scope service categories, so its practice set must rotate across all eight rather than drill compute alone.

Many Domain 3 items hinge on scope: IAM, Route 53 and CloudFront are global services, EC2, RDS and VPC are Regional, and an EBS volume lives in one Availability Zone and attaches only to instances in that zone.

problem_ideas: A 16-question Domain 3 set with two items per task statement; mark which of the eight task statements fell below 70%.
An EC2 instance in us-east-1a cannot see an EBS volume created in us-east-1b; explain why and give the fix (snapshot and restore).
Classify ten services as global, Regional or zonal in under 90 seconds.
A stem asks for a NoSQL key-value store with single-digit-millisecond reads and no servers; pick the service and rule out ElastiCache.
A stem asks to query CSV files in S3 with SQL without loading them anywhere; pick Athena and rule out Redshift.
Domain 3 is about 17 scored items; compute the maximum misses that keep you at 70% in this domain.
Pick the two task statements with the most misses and schedule their 'choosing a service' lessons for replay.
